<issue_description>
Heap-buffer-overflow (out-of-bounds read) in PackLinuxElf32::elf_lookup (src/p_lx_elf.cpp). While walking ELF DT_HASH chains to resolve symbols the code can index past the end of the chains table and invoke a 32-bit read (via the get32/get_le32 path), causing a 4-byte heap OOB read. A malformed or malicious DT_HASH can therefore trigger crashes and potential information disclosure.

import re
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('src/p_lx_elf.cpp')
data = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')

def patch_one(funcname):
    global data
    # add n_chain declaration
    data2, n = re.subn(rf"(\b{re.escape(funcname)}\b[\s\S]*?\n\s*if \(hashtab && dynsym && dynstr\) \{{\n\s*unsigned const n_bucket = get_te32\(&hashtab\[0\]\);)\n(\s*unsigned const \*const buckets = &hashtab\[2\];)",
                     r"\1\n        unsigned const n_chain  = get_te32(&hashtab[1]);\n\2",
                     data, count=1)
    if n != 1:
        raise SystemExit(f'failed to insert n_chain for {funcname}: {n}')
    data = data2

    # insert validation block after dt_offsets loop before if (n_bucket)
    marker = "        }\n        if (n_bucket)"
    insert = (
"        }\n"
"        // Validate DT_HASH extent and make sure buckets/chains dereferences stay in-bounds.\n"
"        // SysV hash layout: [nbucket, nchain, buckets[nbucket], chains[nchain]]\n"
"        if (!l_hash || l_hash <= (void const *)hashtab) {\n"
"            throwCantPack(\"bad DT_HASH end\");\n"
"        }\n"
"        if (!l_sym || l_sym <= (void const *)dynsym) {\n"
"            throwCantPack(\"bad DT_DYNSYM end\");\n"
"        }\n"
"        {\n"
"            upx_uint64_t const words_avail =\n"
"                (upx_uint64_t)(((unsigned char const *)l_hash - (unsigned char const *)hashtab) / sizeof(unsigned));\n"
"            upx_uint64_t const words_need = (upx_uint64_t)2 + (upx_uint64_t)n_bucket + (upx_uint64_t)n_chain;\n"
"            if (words_avail < words_need) {\n"
"                throwCantPack(\"bad DT_HASH size nbucket=%u nchain=%u\", n_bucket, n_chain);\n"
"            }\n"
"        }\n"
"        if (n_bucket)")
    if marker not in data:
        raise SystemExit(f'marker not found for validation block in {funcname}')
    data = data.replace(marker, insert, 1)

    # replace the for-loop in DT_HASH traversal
    old_loop = (
"            for (si= get_te32(&buckets[m]); si; si = get_te32(&chains[si])) {\n"
"                if (l_sym <= &dynsym[si])\n"
"                    throwCantPack(\"bad DT_HASH chain %d\\n\", si);\n"
"                char const *const p= get_dynsym_name(si, (unsigned)-1);\n"
"                if (p && 0==strcmp(name, p))\n"
"                    return &dynsym[si];\n"
"                if (l_sym <= &dynsym[n_visit++])\n"
"                    throwCantPack(\"circular DT_HASH chain %d\\n\", si);\n"
"            }\n")
    new_loop = (
"            for (si = get_te32(&buckets[m]); si; ) {\n"
"                if (n_chain <= si) {\n"
"                    throwCantPack(\"bad DT_HASH chain %d\\n\", si);\n"
"                }\n"
"                // Ensure the 32-bit read of chains[si] is within the DT_HASH region.\n"
"                if (((unsigned char const *)&chains[si]) + sizeof(unsigned) > (unsigned char const *)l_hash) {\n"
"                    throwCantPack(\"bad DT_HASH chain %d\\n\", si);\n"
"                }\n"
"                if (l_sym <= &dynsym[si])\n"
"                    throwCantPack(\"bad DT_HASH chain %d\\n\", si);\n"
"                char const *const p= get_dynsym_name(si, (unsigned)-1);\n"
"                if (p && 0==strcmp(name, p))\n"
"                    return &dynsym[si];\n"
"                if (n_visit >= n_chain || l_sym <= &dynsym[n_visit++])\n"
"                    throwCantPack(\"circular DT_HASH chain %d\\n\", si);\n"
"                si = get_te32(&chains[si]);\n"
"            }\n")

    if old_loop not in data:
        raise SystemExit(f'old loop not found in {funcname}')
    data = data.replace(old_loop, new_loop, 1)

patch_one('Elf32_Sym const *PackLinuxElf32::elf_lookup')
